scope: Reproducible teammate local setup and low-queue comparison profiles

implementation.default_profile: low-latency: Torch FP32, host depth reduction, bounded-2 camera admission
implementation.controls: baseline retains Torch/GPU reduction/12-frame camera window; TensorRT requires an explicit target-built manifest
implementation.supervision: Existing local Web/GPU and LAN supervisors retain ownership and no-retry behavior; run replaces the wrapper process
implementation.lan_contract: Canonical Web port follows the local worker origin; LAN configures only its camera window and cannot change a running worker backend
implementation.isolation: No committed credentials, machine paths, compiled engines, venvs or cloud inference routes; inherited model strategy and optional API keys are cleared

clean_copy_validation.network_condition: Explicit process-only existing HTTP/HTTPS proxy for installation/download verification; not embedded in delivered code
clean_copy_validation.readonly_check: passed from clean source/Web interpreter with explicit existing GPU interpreter

verified_contracts: Bootstrap needs only Python standard library before preparation
Explicit CUDA wheel installation precedes pinned inference dependencies
Existing unrelated environment directories and mismatched model files are preserved and rejected
Missing models publish through an exclusive file link only after bounded complete download and SHA256 verification
Partial, oversized and bad-hash downloads clean only their owned temporary file; no retry
Versioned bootstrap model hashes match independent runtime model identities
Local profiles isolate inherited distance/depth strategy and preserve the parent environment
Only TensorRT profile accepts/requires an explicit engine manifest; no discovery or fallback
Read-only checks do not prepare packages, models, keys or services
LAN endpoint uses the local worker's canonical Web port and never selects a public SSH launcher
